COEN Departments & Degree Programs
Explore the degree programs offered by the College of Engineering (COEN) at Boise State University.
Our programs are designed to equip students with the skills and knowledge needed to excel in the ever-evolving fields of engineering, computer science, and construction.
From undergraduate to graduate degrees, we offer a range of disciplines including Civil, Electrical, Computer Systems, Mechanical, and Materials Science Engineering, among others. Each program combines rigorous academic coursework with hands-on learning experiences, preparing our graduates to become innovative leaders and problem-solvers.
Discover how our degree programs can help you achieve your educational and professional goals.
Get Connected with Admissions
Meet the COEN Advisors
COEN Departments
Our college is home to a diverse array of departments, each dedicated to excellence in education, research, and innovation. Explore our Civil Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Mechanical and Biomedical Engineering, and Construction Management departments, each offering specialized programs and cutting-edge research opportunities. Our Materials Science department pushes the boundaries of engineering materials, while CORe focuses on Cyber Operations and Resilience. Additionally, the Engineering PLUS program provides interdisciplinary education to prepare well-rounded engineers. Discover the unique strengths and opportunities within each department as you embark on your engineering journey with us.
